item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Has there been any effort to publicize the MTFs used so far? I feel like "Cattlewranglers" could have been used for SPCs like Jacobs Ram or Electric Sheep, but since it has only been mentioned once so far, no one has thought to utilize them as they are kind of obscure. My only reason for bringing this up is the idea that funding and resources for the Foundation is finite, and i try to keep that in mind when reading through them. I try to identify something that might only ever be used once or could be replaced by something less resource intensive, such as communication and media monitoring rather than MTF assignment.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I'm not gonna beat the dead "agents happened upon it" horse, others got to it before me.
However. It's interesting to note that there is a certain carelessness to the assignment of MTF's names I occasionally see. For instance, the MTF "See no evil" is a great name, because you can use that MTF for several different SCPs that require a visual cue. "Cattlewranglers", however, is a name that implies a pretty narrow usefulness. Probably only this SCP. What else would they be feasibly used with that implied skill set?
It seems unfeasible to have specialized trained forces that can't be uses in several different situations. They supposed to be multi purpose and mobile, hence Mobile Task Force. It requires resources and funding to train and equip such specialized teams, this seems a little too carelessly tossed in there.

item.content:encoded:
It has come to my attention that 843 might be in need of some testing. Does 843-2 produce milk? If you were to try and eat it, would it make a veggie burger? Exactly what sort of plant is it, anyway? Is the 843-2 we have in containment male or female? Are they all one gender? And how on earth are they aggressive, anyway?

These are many questions. Questions that I honestly don't feel like answering right now. So what I think would be best would be to open up 843 to testing from everyone. Feel free to think up tests, like 'What's inside 843-1?' or 'Does 843-2 make a good veggie burger?'. And feel free to think up what the results are. I don't want to see something awesome like 'Is 843-2 male or female? [DATA EXPUNGEDLOL].' If this doesn't work, I guess I'll do it myself…
